description: How a tool finds the map folder without an option: the folders directly under <project root>/maps/ whose names end in .w3x or .w3m, ignoring case. One is the map folder; none or several is no map folder. `maps` lists the entries of maps/, a folder ending in a slash, a file otherwise, or is null when maps/ is absent. `found` is the map folder's name, or null with `reason`, `none` or `several`. Shared by the tests of reforged-map/typescript-plugin and of the lint rule no-unknown-rawcodes (#595, #582).
